title: Autrey reminds Fats of his brother Lawrence, who was shot protecting him
summary: Fats said Autrey resembled his brother Lawrence Waller, who took a bullet in the hip when a stranger drew a pistol outside a Harlem bar.

story.theme_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and rough clubs of Prohibition
story.community_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and the Prohibition-era clubs

blocks.x: When the group was on the road, were you the one who was closest to Fats?

On the road, or in New York. He and I, we were great pals. We hung out together, and why I answered you so quick, I mean we've been accused of that for so many years, of being -- I was accused of being Fats' right-hand man, and one of those things. I think he liked me a lot too because I reminded him of his brother, Lawrence. Lawrence Waller, yeah, because he used to tell me that. Quite a lot. You sure remind me of my brother Lawrence. I don't see it.
You mean in appearance? Or personality?
What did Lawrence -- was Lawrence a musician?

Older brother, yeah, very nice. Very nice man. He's the one -- he and Fats, and two or three other guys, were making the rounds in Harlem, a hundred and what? 47th Street, and they went in a bar, and they were sitting down having some drinks and whatnot, and some guy came over and butted in and started to start something, so they got up, all left, went out and got -- Fats got in a taxi, and so forth. All of them was getting in the taxi. And this guy ran out,

and they saw him pull a pistol.
So Lawrence moved in to protect Fats, and got shot
in the hip.

So he -- and -- but he -- Fats loved him very, very
much, too much, before that. This was in later years, I mean
after Fats -- after I joined Fats, you know, and I know he
thought so much of Lawrence, and I'm sure he thought more of
him then, because if it hadn't been for Lawrence Fats would
have been a dead man. Be killed, maybe, you know, with that
shot. And for no reason. They didn't know the man. And the
man didn't know them.
He -- I don't know, this thing just happened.
You were very close to Fats then --
